name: Big Tent
why: Building one of each color toward a big game-end payout is a satisfying collector's goal.

name: Sweet Nothings
why: A gift: rivals get silver, you get 2 of any color for each, everyone is happy.

name: Promote
why: A trade, not a theft: the rival loses a member but gets one back, so it stings only a little.

name: Hoarder
why: A once-per-game resource conversion; useful, no real moment.

name: Regular
why: A quiet +1 blue when you buy followers; fine.

name: Stash
why: Resources plus a follower if you recruit; a plain, fine turn.

name: Gather
why: Red that grows by round plus a follower on a recruit; fine.

name: Money Changers
why: Trickle of white from anyone buying followers; fine.

name: Build Up
why: Plain green that grows by round; fine but flat.

name: Kidnapper
why: Takes the leader's member on recruit and again every round start, before round III, with no answer: the victim feels robbed.

name: Tourist
why: Holding many colors then cashing in followers each round start is a fun payoff for the owner.

name: Shopaholics
why: Recruiting twice every turn feels powerful and opens big turns.

name: Sleep In
why: Big purple for going last; a fine timing trade.

name: Polish
why: Turns 2 silver into 4 of any colors; useful fixer, no moment.

name: Splurge
why: A big recruit that also pours in followers is a satisfying spike.

name: Timekeeper
why: Game-end follower per purple member; fine.

name: Recluse
why: Game-end followers for staying small; fine.

name: Gardeners
why: Fills colors you lack; helpful, quiet.

name: Encore
why: Doubling a strong On Recruit is a fun combo moment.

name: Anarchist
why: Every round it can swap a rival's key member for a worse one, before round III, with no block: the victim feels robbed.

name: Allowance
why: White plus a follower on a recruit; fine.

name: Caravan
why: Steady income of each color you hold; fine engine, no spike.

name: Volunteer
why: Cheap vanilla follower; fine filler.

name: Foster Parents
why: Pairs with swaps and steals for a fun payoff when members come over.

name: Recruit Twice
why: Two recruits in one turn is a big, fun turn.

name: Cover
why: Copy an empty action; flexible, fine.

name: Harvest
why: Choose your colors; plain and fine.

name: Cash In
why: Turning a pile of white into followers in round III is a satisfying cash-out.

name: Wallflower
why: Doubles copied resources; fine, needs setup.

name: Roadie
why: Green income scaling with green members; fine.

name: Gossip
why: Followers whenever a turn is skipped; fine.

name: Smooth Talkers
why: Silver paying for any color feels freeing and powerful.

name: Peek
why: Stacking the pile and picking from the top 4 is a clever, fun planning turn.

name: Makeover
why: Yellow and a rearrange; useful, quiet.

name: Toastmaster
why: A follower each Silver space; fine.

name: Alchemists
why: All resources count as any when recruiting: a freeing, powerful feel.

name: Shift Crew
why: Vanilla 4 followers; fine.

name: Desperado
why: Catch-up steals that hit resources, not members; fine and visible.

name: Recruiter
why: +1 red per recruit; fine.

name: Snobs
why: Game-end follower per blue member; fine.

name: Heiresses
why: Once-per-game white per member; fine.

name: Patroness
why: Followers when shop members are sent down; fine.

name: Caterer
why: Silver when silver is gifted; fine.

name: Critic
why: Follower when a rival recruits blue; fine.

name: Impressionist
why: Small resource whenever anyone copies; fine.

name: Extra Hand
why: An extra minion for a round is a strong, fun turn.

name: Patriarch
why: Game-end follower per 2 members; fine.

name: Envy
why: Catching up to the richest rival's silver every round start is a fun, victimless catch-up.

name: Misers
why: Game-end followers for hoarded white; fine.

name: Brokers
why: +1 on White follower gains; fine.

name: Exchange
why: Resources into followers; fine.

name: Out of Style
why: Clears a color from the shop; a visible, mild sting.

name: New Blood
why: Followers for a new color recruit; fine.

name: Drifters
why: Flexible color count; fine.

name: Dyer
why: Yellow income per color held; fine.

name: Cashier
why: Cashing all your white into followers on recruit is a satisfying payoff.

name: Clerk
why: +1 red each round; plain but fine.

name: Doppelganger
why: Copying your best member is a fun combo moment.

name: Stunt Double
why: Repeat the action you just took; fine.

name: Dabblers
why: Counts as 2 wild members; fine.

name: Reprise
why: Copy an action you're on; fine.

name: Old Money
why: Game-end follower per white member; fine.

name: Shake Down
why: The victim chooses their own punishment, pay or lose a member: feels too bad.

name: Bell Ringer
why: A trigger so tangled the owner can't plan for it or notice it firing: no fun to play.

name: Greatest Hits
why: Re-firing every On Recruit at once is a big, fun round III moment.

name: Jack-of-All-Trades
why: Yellow as wild in sets; fine.

name: Courier
why: Resources on consecutive turns; fine.

name: Estate Sale
why: Cast out your own member for white; fine.

name: Landlord
why: White income; fine.

name: Proselytizers
why: A follower per recruit; fine.

name: Hold Up
why: Skips the next turn, a sting but tied to seat order players can see coming.

name: Party Gifts
why: A gift to rivals that pays you followers; everyone gains.

name: Harmonist
why: Game-end follower per full set; fine.

name: Busker
why: Green income; fine.

name: Melting Pot
why: Resources per member color; fine.

name: Hawker
why: Rivals choose to pay you extra or you get it free: a fun, fair tension.
